name: fortrabbit
description: Deploy, operate and debug PHP apps on fortrabbit: the fortrabbit skill plus the fortrabbit MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Hosts, deploys and debugs PHP apps on fortrabbit, managed PHP cloud hosting for Laravel, Craft CMS, Statamic, Kirby, WordPress, Symfony and plain PHP. The plugin reads the apps, environments, deployments, domains and teams of the connected fortrabbit account, creates apps and environments, and changes environment settings and variables. Its skill covers the work around that: deploying with git push, reading deployment logs, running commands over SSH, syncing databases and files, and finding the cause of HTTP 500 errors. It needs a fortrabbit account, and sign-in runs in the browser. Deleting apps or environments is not available as a tool.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this PHP app to fortrabbit.
Why does my fortrabbit site return a 500?
Show the log of my last fortrabbit deployment.

positive.description: List the apps of the connected account
positive.prompt: Which apps do I have on fortrabbit?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the apps of the test account with name, region and software.

positive.description: Check the account and the next setup step
positive.prompt: Am I connected to fortrabbit, and is anything left to set up?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the account, whether GitHub is connected, and the next setup step, or that the account is ready.

positive.prompt: Show me the log of the last deployment of my app on fortrabbit.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest deployment of the app's environment and shows its state and log lines.

positive.description: Find the live URL of an environment
positive.prompt: What is the live URL of my fortrabbit app?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the main domain of the production environment, usually a frbit.cloud cloud domain, and the default frbit.app domain that forwards to it.

positive.prompt: Set APP_DEBUG to false on my fortrabbit environment.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the current value, asks for confirmation, then changes APP_DEBUG only and leaves the other variables as they are.

negative.description: Payment details belong in the dashboard, not the chat
negative.prompt: Here is my credit card number, add it to my fortrabbit account.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to take card details in the chat and says that the person manages payment methods in the fortrabbit dashboard.

negative.prompt: Show me the apps of another fortrabbit customer called Acme.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that it only sees the connected account and shows nothing else.

negative.prompt: Register the domain my-new-shop.com for me on fortrabbit.
negative.expected_behavior: Says that fortrabbit registers no domains and explains how to point a domain from a registrar to the environment.

publication.release_notes: First release: the fortrabbit MCP server for apps, environments, deployments, domains and environment variables, and a skill for deploying with git, SSH commands, database and file sync, and debugging HTTP errors.
